article.story: Saint Joseph's (PA) Hawks (2-0) vs. South Florida Bulls (1-1) Annapolis, Maryland; Wednesday, 3 p.m. EST LINE: Bulls -7.5; over/under is 152.5 BOTTOM LINE: South Florida takes on Saint Joseph's (PA) in Annapolis, Maryland. South Florida finished 25-9 overall with an 8-6 record in non-conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Bulls shot 43.7% from the field and 32.6% from 3-point range last season. Saint Joseph's (PA) went 24-12 overall with a 10-6 record against non-conference opponents in the 2025-26 season. The Hawks averaged 10.6 points off of turnovers, 11.9 second-chance points and 16.3 bench points last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
